title: Next-Gen Innovations through Interdisciplinary Research
teaser: Science webinar on next-generation innovations through interdisciplinary research, jointly presented by Indian Academy of Sciences and tAcT. Speaker: Dr. Sridhar Venkatesh, Vice President and Managing Director, GlaxoSmithKline Pharmaceuticals Ltd.
homepageMatter: On 15 October 2020, the Indian Academy of Sciences and tAcT presented a science webinar featuring Dr. Sridhar Venkatesh, Vice President–South Asia and Managing Director, GlaxoSmithKline Pharmaceuticals Ltd., Bengaluru. He spoke on next-generation innovations through interdisciplinary research, drawing on learnings from healthcare.
